newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's central bank eases reserve rules.
newsitem.headline: Chile's central bank eases reserve rules.

text.p: Chile's central bank said it has lifted reserve requirement rules on small investments to make it easier for investors to bring funds into the country.

Investments and loans of up to $200,000 will no longer be subject to the reserve requirement and the reserve rules will not apply to cumulative investments of up to $500,000 by a single investor in a 12 month period, it said.

"This will allow lesser-sized companies and small investors to bring in capital without being subject to the reserve rules, when these operations do not exceed the limits on individual operations or cumulative values," said the statement.
The reserve requirement rules oblige investors to deposit a percentage of their investment in an interest-free account with the central bank.
